protocol: Selection frozen before scoring. All source document pairs are positive for the same official training query. Each selected span gives specific evidence for one authored time condition. Offsets index whitespace-normalized corpus text.
selection: Targeted exploratory sample across five domains.

cases.query_template: Which passage identifies a formal definition of the second adopted {time} 1964?

early.visible_evidence: Ephemeris second defined in 1954 and revised in 1956.

cases.query_template: Which passage documents a standards organization formally adopting the name hertz {time} 1963?
Which passage describes mathematical work on electromagnetic induction {time} 1855?

early.visible_evidence: Neumann formulated induction mathematically in papers of 1845 and 1847.

late.visible_evidence: Maxwell gave Faraday’s insights a mathematical form in the early 1860s.

cases.query_template: Which passage identifies an original publication of a formulation of quantum mechanics {time} 1 January 1926?

early.visible_evidence: Heisenberg’s cited original paper is dated 1925. The 1968 date belongs to the English translation.

cases.query_template: Which passage identifies a type of Scottish birth record with entries from {time}?

early.visible_evidence: The specified Old Parochial Registers cover births from 1726 to 1854.

late.visible_evidence: Scottish statutory birth records include fields documented for 1855–1918.

cases.query_template: Which passage describes the contents of a United States population census taken {time} 1820?

early.visible_evidence: The 1800 census describes the ages of free white females.

late.visible_evidence: The 1840 population schedules include people in households and pensioners.

cases.query_template: Which passage describes a restriction or phase-out of Canadian private bank notes {time} 1935?

early.visible_evidence: The 1871 Bank Act restricted the denominations that chartered banks could issue.

late.visible_evidence: The last private notes were issued in 1944 and removed by 1950. The 1817 date describes first issuance.

cases.query_template: Which passage identifies a signed instrument concerning the outcome of the 1971 India–Pakistan War {time} 1 January 1972?

early.visible_evidence: The instrument of surrender was signed on 16 December 1971.

late.visible_evidence: The Simla Agreement was signed on 2 July 1972. The 1971 date describes the preceding war.

cases.query_template: Which passage specifically identifies who administered Punjab {time} the 1853 reorganization?

early.visible_evidence: Following the 1849 annexation, the board consisted of Henry Lawrence, John Lawrence and Charles Mansell.

late.visible_evidence: After the reorganization John Lawrence was chief commissioner and Montgomery was his deputy.

cases.query_template: Which passage details a congressional response to the disputed 1876 U.S. presidential election {time} 1880?

early.visible_evidence: Congress established an electoral commission in 1877.

late.visible_evidence: Congress passed the Electoral Count Act in 1887. The 1877 date describes the compromise.

cases.query_template: Which passage describes an Indian government economic policy change {time} 1989?

early.visible_evidence: The early post-independence government restricted domestic and foreign enterprises.

late.visible_evidence: The 1991–92 budget reduced the fertilizer subsidy and removed the sugar subsidy.
